title: 第三章 剧透第十七章 抹杀排名战
content_zh:
林凡静静的等着。
他准备了两个帖子，为的是以防意外。
没过多久，一位中年人从山上飞驰而下。
真的好似飞行。
速度极快，转眼已到近前。
“你就是林凡林居士！”中年人停下后，打量林凡几眼，整了整衣衫，弹了弹衣角，这才稽首询问。
很是客气。
“在下就是林凡，阁下可是宋远桥大侠？”林凡回道。
“当不起大侠之称。”宋远桥微微摆手，忍不住想要询问。
林凡却快一步说道：“宋大侠，事关体大。”
他扫视了一眼左右。
“对对对，林居士，还请山上一叙！”宋远桥侧身相邀。
“请！”林凡示意。
他也暗自松了口气。
你看，这就是名门正派的好处，尤其是有张真人坐镇的武当山。
最差也不会有生命危险。
两人上山。
山路不好走，磕磕绊绊。
宋远桥不急不躁，还不时地介绍沿途各处风景。
林凡率先忍不住了，不好意思道：“宋大侠，林某自幼体弱，不曾习武，走的有些慢了。为了早些见到真人，瞻仰仙颜，还请相助一二。”

“好，宋某僭越了。”宋远桥稍微迟疑，看到林凡额头见汗，抓住他的手臂，速度骤然加快。
林凡身子一轻，就看到两侧山石飞速后退。
“这就是轻功？”
他眼热，心更热。
山上很热闹。
路过之时，小道士纷纷向宋远桥打招呼。
他只是点点头，就快速带着林凡来到了一间会客室，命人奉上茶后，将其它人统统打发了出去。
这才拿出帖子，眸光锐利了几分：“林居士，你说你知道五弟的下落？”
实际上他并不是很相信。
毕竟这位没有修为在身。
可终究要试试。
老五是他的师弟，也是师父的宝贝疙瘩。
“在下确实知道。”林凡点头，却从怀中又取出一个帖子递了过去，“宋大侠，还请你亲自面呈张真人。不要多说，不要多问，真人看过后会召见在下。”
宋远桥眉头一凝，眼神更加锋锐。
霎时间，房间里气氛压抑。
林凡心中一抖，感觉空气粘稠，头顶上好像有一座山峰压下，沉重的让他透不过气来。
“好，还请林居士稍等片刻。”宋远桥最终接过帖子，压抑的气氛也为之一松。
他起身离去。
没过多久，宋远桥回来，神色奇异，却客气道：“林居士，师父邀请，还请前往一叙。”
“请！”林凡彻底放下心来，跟着对方离开房间。

他准备了两个帖子。
给宋远桥的上面写着：我知道张五侠的下落。
content_en:
Lin Fan waited quietly.
He prepared two posts just in case something unexpected happened.
Not long after, a middle-aged man flew down the mountain.
It's really like flying.
The speed was extremely fast, and he was already close in the blink of an eye.
"You are Lin Fan, layman Lin!" After the middle-aged man stopped, he looked at Lin Fan a few times, straightened his clothes, flicked the corners of his clothes, and then asked.
Very polite.
"I am Lin Fan. Are you the hero Song Yuanqiao?" Lin Fan replied.
"I can't be called a hero." Song Yuanqiao waved his hands slightly and couldn't help but want to ask.
Lin Fan took a quick step and said, "Song Daxia, it's a matter of physical importance."
He glanced left and right.
"Yes, yes, Master Lin, please give me a talk on the mountain!" Song Yuanqiao invited him sideways.
"Please!" Lin Fan signaled.
He also secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
You see, this is the benefit of a well-known and decent family, especially Wudang Mountain where Master Zhang is in charge.
At worst, it's not life-threatening.
The two went up the mountain.
The mountain road is difficult to walk and bumpy.
Song Yuanqiao was neither impatient nor impatient, and introduced the scenery along the way from time to time.
Lin Fan was the first to be unable to bear it any longer and said sheepishly: "Master Song, Lin has been weak since he was a child and has never practiced martial arts. He walks a little slowly. In order to see the real person and admire his beauty as soon as possible, please help me."
"Okay, Song has violated the law." Song Yuanqiao hesitated a little, saw sweat on Lin Fan's forehead, grabbed his arm, and speeded up suddenly.
Lin Fan moved lightly and saw the rocks on both sides retreating rapidly.
"Is this Qing Gong?"
His eyes were hot and his heart was even hotter.
The mountains are very lively.
As they passed by, the little Taoist priests greeted Song Yuanqiao one after another.
He just nodded and quickly led Lin Fan to a reception room. After ordering someone to serve tea, he sent everyone else out.
Then he took out the post and his eyes became sharper: "Lin Shi, you said you know the whereabouts of fifth brother?"
In fact, he didn't quite believe it.
After all, this person has no cultivation base.
But I have to try it after all.
Lao Wu is his junior brother and the master's treasure.
"I do know." Lin Fan nodded, but took out another post from his arms and handed it over, "Master Song, please present it to Master Zhang in person. Don't say more, don't ask too many questions, the real person will summon me after reading it."
Song Yuanqiao frowned and his eyes became sharper.
Suddenly, the atmosphere in the room became depressing.
Lin Fan's heart trembled, and he felt that the air was thick, as if there was a mountain peak pressing down on his head, making it so heavy that he couldn't breathe.
"Okay, please wait a moment, Master Lin." Song Yuanqiao finally took the post, and the oppressive atmosphere relaxed.
He got up and left.
Not long after, Song Yuanqiao came back with a strange look on his face, but he said politely: "Lin, Master invited me, please come and talk."
"Please!" Lin Fan was completely relieved and followed the other person out of the room.
He prepared two posts.
It was written to Song Yuanqiao: I know the whereabouts of Zhang Wuxia.
